description.value:
Craves personal acknowledgment above all, and is disproportionately offended by exactly one declared nonbeliever — not humanity in general, one person.

SEEN AND KNOWN — once per day, when someone is watching, treat a failed check as a success instead. The Undoubted has never once been caught looking foolish.

cinderfall.incomplete: This is one of the 7 "Choose Your Bargain" option cards (classfeature, otherTags:["cultist-bargain"], selected by cultist.bargain's ChoiceSet). The mechanical benefit of choosing it is entirely "you can now cast its signature Rite," a sibling spell card in this same folder -- granting it via a static GrantItem pointing at that slug is not resolvable by this repo's own Foundry build pipeline (tools/foundry/build_pack.py: resolve_grants only rewrites system.items slots at build time; resolve_ancestry only rewrites system.ancestry.slug). A cross-slug GrantItem.uuid inside a feat's own system.rules is exactly the already-confirmed-absent case for this pass.
cinderfall.followUp: signature spell 'Seen and Known' still needs its own spell document; the card renders on spells-abilities.html as a spell-entry and its statline/body are authored above
